mapper.select: SELECT pm.material_id, mr.requirement_id, mr.requirement_name, mr.is_required AS required_flag, mr.description, pm.submit_status, pm.current_version_id, pm.file_hash, pm.file_id, fa.file_name, pm.version_no, pm.remark, pm.submitted_at, lr.decision AS review_status, lr.comment AS review_comment, rev_user.real_name AS reviewed_by_name, lr.created_at AS reviewed_at FROM competition_project cp JOIN material_requirement mr ON mr.notice_id = cp.notice_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 AND mr.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pm_inner.* FROM project_material pm_inner JOIN ( SELECT project_id, requirement_id, MAX(version_no) AS max_version_no FROM project_material WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND file_id IS NOT NULL AND current_version_id = material_id GROUP BY project_id, requirement_id ) latest_pm ON latest_pm.project_id = pm_inner.project_id AND latest_pm.requirement_id = pm_inner.requirement_id AND latest_pm.max_version_no = pm_inner.version_no WHERE pm_inner.is_deleted = 0 ) pm ON pm.project_id = cp.project_id AND pm.requirement_id = mr.requirement_id LEFT JOIN file_asset fa ON fa.file_id = pm.file_id AND fa.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mr2.material_version_id, mr2.decision, mr2.comment, mr2.reviewer_id, mr2.created_at FROM material_review mr2 INNER JOIN ( SELECT material_version_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM material_review WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY material_version_id ) latest_mr ON latest_mr.material_version_id = mr2.material_version_id AND latest_mr.max_id = mr2.id WHERE mr2.is_deleted = 0 ) lr ON lr.material_version_id = pm.current_version_id LEFT JOIN sys_user rev_user ON rev_user.user_id = lr.reviewer_id AND rev_user.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cp.project_id = #{projectId} AND cp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY mr.sort_no ASC, mr.requirement_id ASC

SELECT pm.material_id, pm.requirement_id, mr.requirement_name, pm.file_id, fa.file_name, fa.file_ext, fa.file_size, pm.version_no, pm.remark, pm.submitted_at, CASE WHEN pm.current_version_id = pm.material_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS current_version, lr.decision AS review_status, lr.comment AS review_comment, reviewer.real_name AS reviewed_by_name, lr.created_at AS reviewed_at FROM project_material pm JOIN competition_project cp ON cp.project_id = pm.project_id AND cp.is_deleted = 0 JOIN material_requirement mr ON mr.requirement_id = pm.requirement_id AND mr.notice_id = cp.notice_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN file_asset fa ON fa.file_id = pm.file_id AND fa.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT review.material_version_id, review.decision, review.comment, review.reviewer_id, review.created_at FROM material_review review INNER JOIN ( SELECT material_version_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM material_review WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY material_version_id ) latest ON latest.material_version_id = review.material_version_id AND latest.max_id = review.id WHERE review.is_deleted = 0 ) lr ON lr.material_version_id = pm.material_id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.user_id = lr.reviewer_id AND reviewer.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.requirement_id = #{requirementId} AND pm.file_id IS NOT NULL AND pm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY pm.version_no DESC, pm.material_id DESC

SELECT pm.material_id, mr.requirement_id, mr.requirement_name, mr.is_required AS required_flag, mr.description, pm.submit_status, pm.current_version_id, pm.file_hash, pm.file_id, fa.file_name, pm.version_no, pm.remark, pm.submitted_at, lr.decision AS review_status, lr.comment AS review_comment, rev_user.real_name AS reviewed_by_name, lr.created_at AS reviewed_at FROM competition_project cp JOIN material_requirement mr ON mr.notice_id = cp.notice_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 AND mr.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pm_inner.* FROM project_material pm_inner JOIN ( SELECT project_id, requirement_id, MAX(version_no) AS max_version_no FROM project_material WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND file_id IS NOT NULL AND current_version_id = material_id GROUP BY project_id, requirement_id ) latest_pm ON latest_pm.project_id = pm_inner.project_id AND latest_pm.requirement_id = pm_inner.requirement_id AND latest_pm.max_version_no = pm_inner.version_no WHERE pm_inner.is_deleted = 0 ) pm ON pm.project_id = cp.project_id AND pm.requirement_id = mr.requirement_id LEFT JOIN file_asset fa ON fa.file_id = pm.file_id AND fa.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mr2.material_version_id, mr2.decision, mr2.comment, mr2.reviewer_id, mr2.created_at FROM material_review mr2 INNER JOIN ( SELECT material_version_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM material_review WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY material_version_id ) latest_mr ON latest_mr.material_version_id = mr2.material_version_id AND latest_mr.max_id = mr2.id WHERE mr2.is_deleted = 0 ) lr ON lr.material_version_id = pm.current_version_id LEFT JOIN sys_user rev_user ON rev_user.user_id = lr.reviewer_id AND rev_user.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cp.is_deleted = 0
AND cp.project_id = #{projectId}
AND pm.current_version_id IS NOT NULL
AND pm.current_version_id IS NULL
ORDER BY cp.project_id, mr.sort_no ASC, mr.requirement_id ASC
